scope: Reference-only tooling, adapters, qualification, measurement records, documentation, chart and retained evidence. Frozen compiler 11ade4a575cd77050a7ad82b40ba972be660f9095f01714235cf57bd36d50aa6; working-tree SCC/compiler experiments excluded.

checks.selection: Recomputed every median-plus-MAD pilot choice; nine fresh confirmation rounds retain frozen choices, anchors and deduplicated cells. Five raw-direct Wasm self-references verified.
checks.statistics: Recomputed 228 runtime summaries, 39 paired summaries and six geometric summaries; all 30 SVG labels and ten documentation timing rows match raw confirmation data.
checks.controls: Verified 318 production input pins, 32 frozen headers, two patches, 140 artifact build commands, 60 default AOT preparations, 20 target-specific Goose-O2 C generations, CPU-2 runtime commands and seeded execution order. All builds precede sampling.
checks.workloads: Seven catalog entries and three unchanged original helper prefixes verified; adapter oracle and barrier/clock boundaries reviewed.
checks.qualification: Recorded logs show nine runner and four independent-oracle tests passed; both suites are wired into CI.
checks.retention: Independently compared every archive member with disk. All 260 production/smoke guest aliases resolve to 200 canonical artifacts; 103 source-map paths, 41 upstream files, frozen compiler sources and host SDK headers match pins. Retained guests are absent from the omitted-input list.
checks.presentation: Reviewed existing PNG: labels, legends and footnotes visible without overlap. Verified final normalized SVG labels, latest pointer and 41 local documentation links.

limitations: Read-only independent audit; no builds, guest executions, tests, benchmark repetitions or rendering performed for this review.

References are empirical for the pinned workloads/toolchains and shared host. Three screening rounds and nine confirmation rounds do not prove universal ceilings; MAD is dispersion, not a confidence bound, and selections are not re-ranked using confirmation.
Warmed example adapters are separate from full-program binaries. Native ISA flags and direct memory32 versus C-Wasm LP64 memory64 prevent attributing the entire difference to runtime overhead.

External tool executables, Wasmtime shared library, intermediate host objects and SDK sysroot remain omitted as declared; their identities and commands are retained. Final SHA256.json is generated after this review.
